args.message:
Fix round_money to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212

tests/test_money.py expects banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN), but
round_money was quantizing with ROUND_HALF_UP. Switch to
ROUND_HALF_EVEN so the nightly build passes.

args.body:
## Summary
`round_money` in `src/money.py` was quantizing with `ROUND_HALF_UP`, while `tests/test_money.py` (and FIN-212) expect banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`). This caused the nightly build to fail.

## Change
- Switch `round_money` to use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, matching the documented behavior and FIN-212 requirement.

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986` passed, including `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even`.

Closes the nightly build failure.
